args.prompt: @Video1 is a plain grey 3D clay render of ONE continuous 4-second shot: a drone descends along the facade of the Rainbow tower in Tel Aviv (a residential tower wrapped in white, softly undulating curved balcony slabs with planters and frameless glass railings) to the 16th floor and approaches one apartment's terrace, ending in front of its glass sliding door with the living room visible behind the glass. Re-render the SAME footage as a photoreal architectural visualization: keep every frame's camera motion, perspective, horizon, every slab edge, floor line, railing, window mullion and the slider exactly where @Video1 draws them; only replace the clay materials with real ones. Nothing static may change shape, count or position between frames; the building is identical from the first frame to the last. @Image1 is the real look of the FIRST frame: the white curved slabs, planters with small olive trees, slim black-framed floor-to-ceiling glazing, the sea, the Reading power-station chimney, low white buildings and trees, a clear blue sky. Keep exactly this look for the tower, the sea and the city. @Image2 is the real look of the LAST frame: the terrace with its pale stone floor and glass railing, the black-framed sliding glazing with sheer cream curtains, and behind the glass the living room. @Image3 shows that living room's seating from inside: a low modular cream boucle sofa with a chaise end and beige cushions, a low oval pale travertine coffee table with a white vase of green fern, a pale cream rectangular rug, pale oak parquet, a floor lamp with a cream drum shade. Whenever the living room is visible through the glass it is THIS room: no round rug, no jute rug, no blanket on the sofa. Soft bright morning light, clear pale-blue sky, neutral white daylight, consistent exposure throughout. Smooth, continuous, no cuts, no text, no people, no watermark.
